headline: Canadian Prime Minister Says US Offers More in Trade Negotiations
summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney stated that negotiations with the United States on a trade agreement have advanced, noting that the US is asking for less and offering more.
why: Bilateral trade negotiations between major economic partners directly affect cross-border supply chains, tariff structures, and sectoral profitability.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Trade negotiation progress between Canada and the US impacts bilateral economic stability.
